description: This Java class implements the ThingsAggregatorConfig interface for configuring the Ditto Concierge service's Things Aggregator, including timeout and parallelism settings.

classes.name: DefaultThingsAggregatorConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of ThingsAggregatorConfig, providing configuration settings for timeout and concurrency.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance from a Typesafe Config object, using a specified config path and fallback.

methods.name: getSingleRetrieveThingTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured timeout for retrieving a single thing.

methods.name: getMaxParallelism
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of parallel operations allowed.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode for proper hash computation based on configuration fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the configuration instance.
